issues.reason: The rule half stands — Compound concepts licenses only modifier_noun / verb_object / verb_particle fusions, so an adjective + head noun + PP complement is not a licensed compound — but with no rule for a PP-complemented predicate nominal this is gap territory, and the resulting KindProperty atom is true of the sentence and well-typed, which the calibration line makes acceptable rather than a defect.

Ordinary Inheritance distributes through member-inheritance, so it would assert of an arbitrary hit man that he is a popular subject for TV movies — content the sentence does not state — and KindProperty is precisely the non-distributing head provided to block that.

This objects to lost reasoning reach, not to any atom being false, ill-typed or over-asserted; it restates the same uncovered construction the reviewer filed as a gap (a predicate nominal with a PP complement has no licensed slot for the PP's object).

The adjective+noun rule fuses only recognized kinds (term of art / nationality / role title / material adjective) and never incidental-evaluative description, and the exposed bare `popular` strips the "for TV movies" restriction, asserting unrestricted popularity — exactly what the forKind comparison-class rule forbids ("do not also assert the plain (Member X <scale>)").

gaps_confirmed: predicate nominal carrying a PP complement ("X is a subject for Y") — no rule attaches a PP to a copular nominal complement, so the PP's object cannot be surfaced as a referable kind
new_gaps: restricted-domain evaluative predication ("popular FOR TV movies", "useful for beginners") has no nominal analogue of the adjectival `forKind` comparison-class form, so the restriction can only be buried inside a symbol
repair_summary: Removed (Inheritance popular_subject_for_tv_movies popular), the over-asserting exposure of the restricted evaluative modifier; the head-noun genus and the KindProperty atom are kept unchanged.
notes: The fused symbol is left standing as tolerable gap-territory improvisation, consistent with "leave opaque for now (don't force)" for non-standard compounds; note it is also unlemmatized (tv_movies, not tv_movie), which no filed issue names.
